worldcombat.skill.slash.summary: Plant your feet, raise the blade overhead and drive one diagonal cleave down a narrow corridor: every foe in the lane takes contact damage and the strike point flashes white. It has the family's raised critical chance - the swift form is faster and wider, the heavy form is slower and heavier.
worldcombat.skill.slash.description.0: The cleave deals one hit of about %1$s contact damage to every enemy in the corridor, and lands critical hits more often.
worldcombat.skill.slash.description.1: The lane is %1$s blocks long and %2$s blocks half-wide, reaching %3$s blocks above the feet.
worldcombat.skill.slash.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.slash.growth.0: From level %1$s the cleave rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.slash.growth.1: From level %1$s the cut reaches %2$s blocks deep.
worldcombat.skill.slash.use.1: Critically strike more often than the family
worldcombat.skill.slash.preference.heavy: On (heavy): 116% power and 0.3 blocks more depth, at 0.08 blocks less blade width, +4 preparation and +8 cooldown. Off (swift): a faster draw, 0.1 blocks more width and faster recovery, at 92% power.
worldcombat.skill.slash.preference.ai.ma: Beyond this distance it closes in instead of cleaving. Larger values open with the cleave from further out.
worldcombat.skill.slash.preference.ai.fi: On: below 45% health a target is chosen first so the cleave can finish it. Off: it ranks the move as an ordinary mid-range slash whatever the health.
